results.id: ROWFILTER inner-join Merge Join [Create And Update Heir]
results.detail: Raw DTSX: JoinType=2, NumKeyColumns=3, TreatNullsAsEqual=true. Left <- Sort (Heir file via Trim All Input Columns 1) keys 1 gen_region_STR_INT, 2 gen_portfolionumber, 3 gen_requestnumber, which are Heir-file external columns MACHOZ, MIS_TIK, MIS_BAKASHA; right <- Sort 1 (Contact file via Trim All Input Columns) keys 1 MACHOZ, 2 MIS_TIK, 3 MIS_BAKASHA. Pairing correct; fileKeys correctly name both connections (Source - Heir Details / Source - Contact Details), fileFields show bare names once. Upstream of Create Heir and Update Heir (the only writers in the flow). Note: neither Sort eliminates duplicates (6932, 7084), so several Contact rows with the same key would multiply heir rows; the expression mentions dropping only (whether the files can hold duplicate keys is unknown).

notes: Scope: INNER Merge Joins (JoinType=2) upstream of CRM writers.
